trademark status

  • CURIE: gmeow:trademarkStatus
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trademarkStatus
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/rights
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The status of a trademark — one of the gmeow:TrademarkStatus values (unregistered ™ / registered ® / pending / expired / cancelled). Functional.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Trademark -> gmeow:TrademarkStatus; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:trademarkStatus from gmeow:Trademark to gmeow:TrademarkStatus when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Trademark, gmeow:TrademarkStatus

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to record the registration status of a trademark — unregistered ™, registered ®, pending, expired, or cancelled — by referencing a gmeow:TrademarkStatus value.

Avoid when

  • Avoid using it for copyright or licence standing (gmeow:copyrightStatus / gmeow:licenseFamily) and avoid deleting a lapsed mark — set gmeow:trademarkStatusExpired and record gmeow:validUntil (Principle 10).

How to use

  • Set gmeow:trademarkStatus once per Trademark (functional) to a gmeow:TrademarkStatus value; on lapse, change the value and add gmeow:validUntil rather than removing the record.

Examples

  • ex:blackcatTM gmeow:trademarkStatus gmeow:trademarkStatusRegistered.
